baseline_scope: Reuse all139 actual completed0.37 optimizer runs, with every failure and regression. Fresh baselines load all seven saved0.37 runtime modules, including the original independent objective search and noisy terminal recommendation policy.

policy.evidence: Paired constraint predictions made before each new optimizer observation; the research data fit both models but do not count as prior-adoption trials

evaluation.rule: Public evaluation coordinates and all final Program/GP predictions are frozen after each optimizer run. After every selected run is complete, a separate actual simulator stream supplies shared measurements and evaluator-only true constraint means. Evaluation calls never enter the controller and are reported separately.
evaluation.additional_requested_metrics: Record which experimental controls provide useful measured objective values, objective prediction errors on actual future observations, final objective-GP predictions on the same frozen independent controls when available, and the best measured point after the mechanism change. Preserve the original constraint Program/GP errors, confirmation and revision sequence, feasibility, and paid costs.

accounting: Research acquires 32 actual full objective/constraint vectors once per distinct initial task and shares them across both arms and same-task stable/change profiles. All loaded calls count toward each arm's N64. New revision questions replace ordinary optimizer calls inside the same remaining 32 calls; full history is retained. Historical reuse, new acquisition, extra model compute, and independent evaluation calls are separate.
metrics: final Program and active GP generalization MSE
common misfit, question, fresh validation, and scope adoption sequence
scope: All previous139 cases are development. Three unused seeds each provide six ordinary confirmation cases (two noise levels, true change, and two stable mechanisms) plus three separate noisy stress cases: one constraint outlier, outlier followed by true change, and objective-only change with unchanged constraint. Preserve all outcomes.
reuse_accounting: Reuse139 actual baseline runs, all existing initial measurements, and independent evaluation measurements. Run139 new development arms and both arms on27 fresh cases: 193 actual new optimizer runs or6176 online calls. Every arm remains32 initial plus32 online calls. Report objective and constraint search together and separately, all GP forecast counts, coverage/confirmation/validation actions, and paid rejected evidence.
baseline_revision_evidence: Keep the original four-observation batch size and nine-times-frozen-reference threshold. Nonoverlapping actual measurement batches reopen research when both models' batch MSE exceed the threshold and at least two individual rows exceed it for both models. The new scope starts at the earliest such counterexample and retains every subsequently paid row. Eight coverage calls and four fresh validation calls remain inside N64. No change labels, times, or truth values reach the controller.
research_initialization: Use the saved0.37 claim compiler for fresh initial research; retain the unchanged public completion rule to32 actual full vectors. Both arms share the same initial measurements and executable prior; same-task stress profiles reuse that initialization.

baseline_method.independent_goal_models: Fit affine and additive quadratic objective models from the current paid scope, including initial vectors. Compare five cross-validation folds grouped by entire control coordinates, preserving repeated observations in the same fold. Require identifiable designs and cross-validation error lower than a fold-training-mean baseline. Refit after four new paid observations.
baseline_method.goal_opportunity: Offer a previously unmeasured control only when learned objective gain exceeds the paired-fold standard deviation, the existing objective GP also predicts improvement over its best actually measured feasible control, and the existing robust constraint decision predicts feasibility. Objective exploration is available while constraint research is monitoring; constraint confirmation/research retains priority.
baseline_method.candidate_pool: Use the learned objective analytic optimum, 33-grid sweeps along each public coordinate through that optimum and the current incumbent, then one further coordinate sweep recentered on the best model-predicted feasible point. No evaluator solution or change label is supplied.
baseline_method.noisy_recommendation: Within the final four remaining calls, compare the best empirical measured-mean control and best GP-ranked actually measured feasible control. If they differ and their GP objective gap is within two comparison standard deviations, acquire one actual repeat at each control. These measurements are inside the original N64. The cognitive adapter no longer allows a raw noisy empirical objective to override GP terminal ranking.
baseline_method.accounting: The independent objective-search cap is 20000 compute units, separate from the unchanged 20000 constraint-research cap. Export all objective search fits/predictions, actual GP mean/epistemic/noise prediction counts, goal-exploration and goal-confirmation calls, and observed outcomes. Measured improvement over a noisy incumbent is reported as measured improvement and is not interpreted as true objective gain.
baseline_method.unchanged: Retain0.36 common-misfit reference, actual constraint confirmation, observation repair, candidate competition, and objective-aware world-revision experiments. All paid observations remain in N64.

outlier_control: The actual simulator runs normally and its constraint output receives the frozen +1.0 observation disturbance on the thirteenth online call only. Objectives, future measurements, and evaluator truth remain unchanged. A report-only log records the disturbance; the runtime receives only ordinary measured outputs and public controls. The corresponding ordinary stable case receives no disturbance. Initial data and final evaluation measurements are shared with that stable case.
mixed_control: The StatePolicy simulator supplies one +1.0 constraint observation at global stage41 (online9), with unchanged objective and future observations. Starting at global stage45 (online13), both actual objective and constraint mechanisms switch to RZDT2. The runtime receives only public controls and ordinary simulator outputs; changes and disturbances are report-only. This asks whether observation repair preserves sensitivity to later drift.
objective_only_control: Starting at global stage45, objectives f1/f2 use the upstream RZDT2 mean mechanism, while f3 retains StatePolicyRZDT1. A script-owned StatePolicyRZDT1 subclass composes the upstream deterministic mean methods and inherits the same TestProblem.simulate: one three-output Gaussian draw is one actual observation, with no uncharged second simulator query. Final independent evaluation uses this same hybrid mechanism. The controller receives ordinary controls and measured outputs, without change labels.

joint_research_scope.monitoring: Continue monitoring actual pre-observation dual-predictor errors during collecting, validating, and unresolved research. Four consecutive distinct controls with both errors at most the existing nine-times-reference threshold establish recovered local predictive accuracy.
joint_research_scope.counterexample: A later common strong error requests an actual same-control confirmation only when original remaining N and remaining20000 constraint-search compute permit. Freeze the original predictions and use the existing confirmation rule.
joint_research_scope.confirmed: Preserve the previous episode with status superseded_by_new_evidence. Start a new research evidence scope at the confirmed anchor, buy coverage within the original remaining calls, and preserve four future validation observations and the original acceptance threshold.
joint_research_scope.refuted: Resume the interrupted frozen candidate and control queue, including proposal or validation when the interruption occurred at a batch boundary.
joint_research_scope.observation_repair: If the repeated evidence supports an isolated bad constraint observation, exclude its disputed constraint from fitting while retaining its paid objective measurement and complete paid history.

development_scope_only_probe.method: saved0.37 adapter, goal policy and adoption policy with new JointModelRevision only

objective_search.pacing: Run ordinary goal planning after four newly paid rows; continue inexpensive monitoring on new outcomes. Reuse a model whose recent actual prediction error remains within nine times its frozen cross-validation loss.
objective_search.screening: Screen public goal candidates using the frozen executable objective model and its folds before expensive GP/HVD forecasts. Predict up to six feasible observed incumbents for ordinary planning, while terminal ranking comparisons inspect all measured feasible controls.
objective_search.compute_reserve: Within the existing20000 objective-search cap, retain the dimension- and row-count-based cost of another complete grouped fit and validation-pool planning. Release this reserve only for a measured objective-scope counterexample.
objective_search.scope_detection: For four new monitored objective outcomes, require at least two squared errors above9*max(current_model_cv_loss,1e-7), and mean squared error above that threshold. Begin objective-only scope research at the first failed observation without changing the constraint scope.
objective_search.scope_validation: Acquire identifying evidence when needed, fit the existing objective families on the new scope, freeze the candidate, then buy four future validation observations. Accept only when mean(previous_GP_error-candidate_error)-2*standard_error(paired_error_gains)>1e-7.
objective_search.installation: After acceptance, rebuild the actual output0 GP/HVD using the new scope and keep the constraint predictor and its scope unchanged. Preserve all paid observations in the ledger; record actual applied scope and its training/validation indices.
objective_search.compute_reserve_formula: For d public dimensions and n=max(12,2*(2*d+1),plan_rows+4), reserve5*n*(3*d+2)+2*n+5*(1+33*d+n+4) objective-search units; remaining total cap stays20000.
objective_search.identifying_experiments: Group complete control coordinates by unique first occurrence index modulo5, keeping replicates together. Require at least3 held-out groups and full rank2*d+1 for every leave-group additive-quadratic training design. Rank candidate directions first by deficient affected folds receiving an independent direction and then by summed log(1+vT*pinv(DT*D+1e-6I)*v). Expand public33-grid axis controls lazily through trusted measured feasible centers, ordered by measured constraint mean, then other measured post-scope centers. Earlier same-constraint-scope feasible coordinates may locate experiments; only actual post-scope objective labels enter the new fit. Re-evaluate real GP/HVD feasibility and quantize every offered control; skip measured controls. Each expanded pool costs its actual size times2*d+1. Coverage ends at grouped identifiability or4 remaining calls, when an identifiable simpler candidate can proceed to4future validations.
objective_search.validation_control_refresh: Keep the objective candidate and its training rows frozen. Cache its predictions for existing validation controls, and append newly measured locations to that pool as paid observations arrive, charging one mean-prediction unit for each new location. A newly feasible measured location can be selected for a future paid validation replicate; its earlier observed objective is not used to validate the candidate retroactively. The same four-observation future-prediction adoption threshold remains unchanged.

development_amendment.reason: Fixed counterexample-centered slices lacked grouped independent directions after real feasibility filtering; frozen validation-control pools ignored later measured feasible locations. Original failed trajectories and costs remain preserved.
